agents.title: AI agents
agents.description: The instructions, skills, hooks and MCP servers your coding agents load, and the permissions they run with.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Your dependencies and the package managers that install them: the cooldown, install scripts, known vulnerabilities and deprecations.

software.title: Software
software.description: Software installed on this machine and how it updates: tools and apps newer than the cooldown, and automatic updates.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Credentials a malicious package running as you could read on disk, and credentials leaked into code.

malware.title: Malware
malware.description: Known malicious packages and releases, and protection against installing them.

network.title: Network
network.description: Connections and services on this machine that others could reach or listen to.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Packages and tools that report on you: telemetry and tracking.

overview.title: Overview
overview.policy: Packages newer than {days} days are held back · findings at {severity} or above count
overview.noneBody: Findings at {severity} or above in {scope} appear here.

category.copyTitle: One brief for an AI coding agent covering every finding shown, to check before you copy it
category.noLensBody: Turn one on above to check for {category}.
category.noMatchBody: Try another topic, a lower severity or a different search.

lens.offUntil: Off until you turn it on.

finding.copyPromptTitle: Shows the brief for an AI coding agent, to check before you copy it

network.visibility: Programs on this machine that accept TCP connections. Only programs running as you are visible; system services that run as administrator are not.
network.loading: Asking the system what is listening…
network.reachableNote: Other devices on the same Wi-Fi or LAN can connect to these, unless a firewall blocks them.
network.noneReachable: Nothing accepts connections from your network
network.localNote: Bound to localhost: only programs on this machine can connect.

identities.title: Identities
identities.description: The accounts this Mac can act as: your git author, SSH keys, and the accounts signed in to cloud, registry and AI tools. Lenstica shows names only, never a key or token, and notes where one is kept in a plain file that any program you run can read.
identities.empty: No signed-in accounts or keys found.

repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.description: Every repository in the folders Lenstica searches, with its remote, branch and worktrees. Settings → Projects chooses the folders.
repositories.empty: No repositories in the folders Lenstica searches. Settings → Projects chooses them.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: Installed apps, with their versions, where each came from (the App Store, Homebrew, Apple or somewhere else), and what each is allowed to do: the permissions System Settings spreads over Privacy & Security, or a Linux app's sandbox.

containers.title: Containers
containers.description: Containers, running and stopped, in Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Colima, Rancher Desktop and Podman. Nothing is started to look.
containers.empty: No containers. Those you create with Docker or Podman show here.

virtual-machines.title: Virtual machines
virtual-machines.description: Virtual machines in Lima, Colima, Podman, Multipass, Tart, UTM, Parallels, VMware Fusion, VirtualBox and Vagrant. Nothing is started to look.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Extensions in your editors (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium, Zed) and browsers (Chrome, Brave, Edge, Arc, Vivaldi, Firefox). They run with access to your code, the pages you visit, or both.

tagNotes.credentialsInFile: A token, password or key is written in this file, where any program running as you can read it.
tagNotes.allSites: It can read and change every website you visit.
tagNotes.notFound: Lenstica could not find this app or program on this Mac. It may have been removed with its permission left behind, which you can remove in System Settings, or be a helper inside another app.

fullDiskAccess.title: Full Disk Access
fullDiskAccess.about: Can read and change every file, including other apps' data, mail, messages and browser history.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.about: Can see and control every app: read windows, click and type.

screenRecording.title: Screen & System Audio Recording
screenRecording.about: Can see everything on your screen and hear the sound your Mac plays.

inputMonitoring.title: Input Monitoring
inputMonitoring.about: Can read every key you press and every mouse movement, in every app.

automation.title: Automation
automation.about: Can control another app and act in it as you.

developerTools.title: Developer Tools
developerTools.about: Can run software that skips macOS's security checks.

appManagement.title: App Management
appManagement.about: Can update or delete other apps.

appData.title: Other apps' data
appData.about: Can read the data other apps keep in their own folders.

remoteDesktop.title: Remote Desktop
remoteDesktop.about: Can show and control this Mac from another computer.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.about: Can read and change your contacts.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.about: Can read and change your calendars.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.about: Can read and change your reminders.

desktopFolder.title: Desktop folder
desktopFolder.about: Can read and change the files on your Desktop.

documentsFolder.title: Documents folder
documentsFolder.about: Can read and change the files in Documents.

downloadsFolder.title: Downloads folder
downloadsFolder.about: Can read and change the files in Downloads.

networkVolumes.title: Network volumes
networkVolumes.about: Can read and change files on network drives.

removableVolumes.title: Removable volumes
removableVolumes.about: Can read and change files on USB drives and memory cards.

mediaLibrary.title: Media & Apple Music
mediaLibrary.about: Can read your music and media library.

speechRecognition.title: Speech Recognition
speechRecognition.about: Can send what you say to speech recognition.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
bluetooth.about: Can find and connect to Bluetooth devices.

motion.title: Motion & Fitness
motion.about: Can read motion and fitness data.

focus.title: Focus
focus.about: Can see whether a Focus is on.

home.title: Home
home.about: Can see and control your Home accessories.

passkeys.title: Passkeys Access for Web Browsers
passkeys.about: Can use your passkeys to sign in to websites.

networkExtension.title: Network extension
networkExtension.about: Can see, filter or redirect all of this Mac's network traffic.

endpointSecurity.title: Endpoint security extension
endpointSecurity.about: Can watch every program, file and process on this Mac.

driverExtension.title: Driver extension
driverExtension.about: Runs a driver that talks to hardware directly.

cameraExtension.title: Camera extension
cameraExtension.about: Adds a camera other apps can use.

unsandboxed.title: Not sandboxed
unsandboxed.about: Runs with everything you can do: all your files, the network, your devices and other apps.

allFiles.title: All files
allFiles.about: Can read and change every file you can, anywhere on the system.

homeFolder.title: Home folder
homeFolder.about: Can read and change everything in your home folder, including other apps' settings and keys.

systemFolders.title: System folders
systemFolders.about: Can read the operating system's own files.

folders.title: Folders
folders.about: Can read or change these folders.

sandboxEscape.title: Run commands outside the sandbox
sandboxEscape.about: Can run any command outside its sandbox, as you.

sessionBus.title: Every app on the session bus
sessionBus.about: Can talk to every app in your desktop session.

keyring.title: Passwords in the keyring
keyring.about: Can ask for the passwords stored in your keyring.

sshAgent.title: Your SSH keys
sshAgent.about: Can use your SSH keys to sign in to servers.

gpgAgent.title: Your GPG keys
gpgAgent.about: Can use your GPG keys to sign and decrypt.

x11.title: X11 display
x11.about: Uses X11, where an app can see other windows and send them keystrokes.

allDevices.title: All devices
allDevices.about: Can use every device: cameras, USB devices, game controllers and more.

inputDevices.title: Input devices
inputDevices.about: Can read input devices, such as keyboards, directly.

debugging.title: Debugging other processes
debugging.about: Can inspect and change other processes in its sandbox.

audio.title: Sound and microphone
audio.about: Can play sound and record from the microphone.

assets.permissionsNote: What it is allowed to do beyond its own files.
assets.notRunning: Not running: {names}. What they hold shows here once they are started.
assets.blocked: macOS does not let Lenstica read {names} without Full Disk Access, so what they hold is missing here. Lenstica only reads; it changes nothing there.

notes.userPermissionsHidden: macOS keeps the permissions you give apps yourself (camera, microphone, contacts, photos, folders, Automation and the like) where no other app can read them, even with Full Disk Access. System Settings → Privacy & Security shows them.

assets.unsupported: Lenstica cannot list these on this system yet.
assets.noMatchBody: Try another source or a different search.
assets.findingsNote: Findings with a location in it.

prompt.title: Prompt for your AI agent
prompt.editTitle: Change how prompts are written: Settings → AI agents

general.title: General
general.about: The cooldown, what needs attention, and the app.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.about: Desktop notifications for new findings. Each finding is notified once; everything is still listed in the window and the menu.

managers.title: Package managers
managers.about: Which package managers Lenstica sets the minimum age in and keeps an eye on, and how they install.

projects.title: Projects
projects.about: Where lenses look for projects, lockfiles, secrets and agent instructions.

checks.title: Checks
checks.about: What the package and software lenses look at. Turn lenses themselves on or off in their category.

agents.title: AI agents
agents.about: Let a coding agent read Lenstica's findings and fix them, and choose how prompts for agents are written.

groups.lookNote: The folders lenses search. Each repository found there is a project in the window's project picker.
groups.perLensNote: Lenses that are on. A lens that is off is not notified either.
groups.managedNote: One that is off is left exactly as it is.
groups.repositoriesNote: Every repository and worktree found under the folders above. Turning one off adds it to Exclude; leaving out a repository leaves out its worktrees too.
groups.agentToolsNote: Every finding also has Copy prompt for AI agent, in the window and in the menu bar.
groups.promptsNote: How Copy Prompt for AI Agent, lenstica prompt and the MCP server write the prompts they hand to an agent. Saved in [prompts] in the settings file.

fields.minDaysWhy: 7 days would have kept out 8 of the 10 best-known supply-chain attacks of 2024-2025; most are caught and pulled within a week.
fields.autoApply: Re-apply automatically when a package manager drifts or is newly installed
fields.alertSeverity: Lowest severity that needs attention (menu bar icon, counts, lenstica check)
fields.roots: Include: project folders to search, one per line. List single repositories here to search only those.
fields.exclude: Exclude: folders to leave out, one per line. A path skips that folder and everything in it; a bare name (fixtures) skips every folder called that.
fields.worktrees: Also every git worktree of the repositories found there
fields.auditGlobal: Include global installs (npm -g, pnpm -g, uv tools, pip --user, cargo install)
fields.auditIgnore: Packages never to flag: name or name@version, one per line
fields.softwareManagers: The package managers themselves (npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, Deno, uv, pip, Poetry, Cargo)
fields.softwareHomebrew: Homebrew formulae (sqlite, node, git…), dated by their published bottle
fields.softwareCasks: Homebrew casks (apps), dated by their download; apps that update themselves are skipped
fields.softwareNode: Node.js, when it is not from Homebrew
fields.softwareIgnore: Software never to flag: name or name@version, one per line
fields.blockScripts: Block dependencies' install scripts (npm ignore-scripts, Yarn enableScripts: false)
fields.noAutoUpdate: Stop Homebrew updating itself before every install (HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 in ~/.homebrew/brew.env). New versions then arrive only with brew update.
fields.appearanceNote: System follows your system's light or dark setting.
fields.languageNote: System uses your system's language when Lenstica speaks it, else English.
fields.autostart: Start the menu bar app at login
fields.notifyFixes: Also when Lenstica restores a package manager's setting by itself
fields.applyTitle: Write the minimum age into every package manager that is on
fields.noRepos: No git repositories under the folders above.
fields.excludedTitle: Left out by a parent folder, its main checkout, or a folder name in Exclude
fields.skillInstalled: Installed at {path}. Teaches the agent the Lenstica CLI.
fields.skillNotInstalled: Teaches the agent the Lenstica CLI. Installs to {path}.
fields.mcpOther: MCP server for other agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor…)

templates.findingNote: Copy Prompt for AI Agent on a single finding.
templates.findingsNote: A prompt for many at once; {{findings}} is each one written with the list template.
templates.itemNote: One finding inside the several-findings prompt.
templates.resetTitle: Go back to Lenstica's own template
templates.help: Click a value to insert it. {shown} keeps its text only when there is a remedy; {hidden} only when there is not.

menu.offThirdParty: Off · third party, opt in from Lenstica

notify.title: Lenstica
notify.test: Test notification. New findings will appear like this.
notify.badSettings: {error}. Lenstica keeps its last good settings.

toast.copiedOne: Copied a prompt for your AI agent
toast.ignoredListener: No longer flagging {entry} on your network
toast.lensBusy: That lens is running; try again when it finishes
